release_notes: Status updates now authenticate with the agent token instead of a guessable user id.
Heartbeat is sent again: the previous build called the policy endpoint by mistake and never reached /api/heartbeat.
Screenshot upload is sent again: the previous build had no destination URL and always failed.
Activity tracking runs while the workstation is unlocked; it was previously confined to the locked branch.
A failed self-update no longer looks like a successful one: the updater retries the copy, records the outcome in apply-update.log, and says so when it had to restart the old build.
Updating mid-session now ends the session and marks the employee Offline first, instead of leaving them Online until the offline checker reaps them.
First build produced from a source tree that compiles; 1.0.4 was advertised but never built.
Self-update can now be applied. The installer script looked for its payload under /Applications while the agent installs updates into the user's home, so every self-update failed at the last step.
Status updates now authenticate with the agent token instead of a guessable user id.
Reports version 1.0.2 so the update channel can distinguish builds.
